💼 Personal Executive Assistant
 🌍 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America.

About Our Client
Our client is a busy founder who needs dependable support across personal administration, scheduling, household coordination, and family logistics. They've documented their systems for recurring tasks, including travel preferences, ordering habits, and decision-making processes, so the right hire can execute with confidence from day one.
About the Role
We're looking for a Personal Executive Assistant to support a founder and their family across personal administration, scheduling, household coordination, family logistics, and social events. The role is primarily personal: the starting point is appointment making, and everything else builds from there as trust is established.
You'll access a shared brain of documented preferences and systems daily and execute from it. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. The ideal hire is proactive, confident stating their own needs and preferences, takes full ownership of tasks end to end, and uses AI tools, including Claude Cowork, as a real part of how they work.
Responsibilities

- Make outbound calls during business hours to schedule and coordinate appointments, the starting point and core of the role

- Set up medical, personal, and professional appointments for the founder and their family

- Sync across multiple calendars, including the founder, partner, and childcare, and manage conflicts proactively

- Coordinate with the nanny on scheduling and logistics

- Use the shared brain daily to execute tasks from documented preferences and systems rather than asking repeated clarifying questions, and help keep it current

- Use Claude Cowork and other AI tools as a core part of planning and executing tasks, and help refine how AI is used across personal and household operations

- Support planning and logistics for hosted dinners and community events

- Manage takeout ordering from documented preferred restaurants and order history, placing orders directly via DoorDash or similar platforms

- Assist with family logistics, including baby-related tasks and family administrative tasks, using established systems

What We're Looking For

- Proven experience as a personal assistant, household manager, or family EA supporting a high-trust principal

- Genuinely proactive, taking ownership of tasks end to end without waiting for detailed direction

- Comfortable stating your own preferences and needs as part of a healthy working relationship

- Confident making outbound calls during US business hours to coordinate appointments and logistics on behalf of others

- Familiarity with Claude Cowork, or strong willingness and aptitude to learn it quickly, as AI fluency is expected

- Discreet, reliable, and highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Comfortable working within documented systems and preferences rather than building from scratch

Nice to Have

- Experience with Claude Cowork or similar AI workflow tools

- Background coordinating household staff, childcare logistics, or family scheduling

- Experience supporting social event planning or community hosting

- Familiarity with managing shared documentation systems or knowledge bases

Work Schedule

- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work

- Availability during US Pacific Time business hours

Compensation & Time Off

- Compensation paid in USD

- Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th

- 
Paid Time Off according to company policy

- 
Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements
Please submit:

- An updated resume

- A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your experience supporting a principal across personal and household logistics, and explaining how you use AI tools as part of your daily workflow

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:
1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team
Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.
We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

scraped.description:
Executive Assistant – Irth Solutions
Job Type: Full-Time 
Location: Columbus, Ohio (Preferred); Open to Eastern and Central Time Zones 
Department: G&A
Reports To: VP, Talent Success in support of the Chief Commercial Officer primarily and the C-Suite executive
Company Overview
Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.
Position Summary
Irth Solutions is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and supplemental support to the CEO and other senior leaders.
Working closely with the existing Executive Assistant and broader administrative team, this individual will manage complex executive calendars, coordinate travel and events, track meeting agendas and action items, oversee day-to-day office operations, and develop scalable administrative processes.
The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, able to multitask, self-directed, flexible across leadership priorities, comfortable in a fast-changing, growing organization, and trusted with confidential information. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization and enjoys building efficient processes that support executive effectiveness.
This is a full-time position. While there is a preference for candidates within commuting distance of our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, we are considering all Eastern and Central time zone candidates.
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Support & Calendar Management

- Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the CCO and supplemental support for the rest of the C-Suite leaders, including but not limited to: scheduling and coordinating meetings, conferences, and calls with internal and external parties across time zones and functions.

- Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and adjustments to ensure optimal time management.

- Prepare meeting agendas and relevant documents for all appointments and events.

- Maintain and track executive agendas, ensuring all key meetings, deadlines, and deliverables are met.

- Provide reminders and follow up on action items from meetings and projects.

- Maintain files, records, and other documents for the executives, ensuring confidentiality and organization.

- Assist with presentations, reports, and other important documents as needed.

- Prioritize competing executive requests, exercising judgment on what should be moved, protected, delegated, or escalated.

- Flex across additional executives and shifting leadership priorities as the organization evolves.

2. Travel & Event Coordination

- Manage travel arrangements, accommodations, and itineraries, covering flights, lodging, ground transportation, and expense documentation.

- Coordinate logistics for internal and external events, including company meetings, conferences, webinars, and team-building activities.

- Ensure events run smoothly and efficiently, managing the setup, equipment, and supplies.

3. Process Improvement & Administrative Infrastructure

- Develop and maintain administrative processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation, including through AI tools.

- Create repeatable executive-support practices that can be shared across the team.

- Help establish scalable administrative infrastructure as Irth grows.

4. Office Operations & Employee Experience

- Oversee daily office operations, including office supplies, equipment maintenance, and vendor management.

- Maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.

- Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

- Coordinate logistics for office supplies, equipment, and materials.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:

- Ensure the CCO's calendar and schedule are organized, accurate, and aligned with business priorities.

- Provide reliable, proactive administrative support with minimal oversight.

- Help the CCO stay focused by anticipating needs and managing follow-through.

- Establish strong working relationships with the existing Executive Assistant and administrative team.

- Improve administrative workflows through documentation, consistency, and thoughtful use of technology.

- Ensure travel, meetings, events, and office operations are handled efficiently.

- Contribute to a scalable administrative support structure as Irth continues to grow.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite executives.

- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills.

- 3-5 years experience using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot or Claude.

- Ability to work on-site in Columbus, OH on a hybrid schedule; or if hired as remote employee, travel as needed to support executive team (less than 15% of the year)

- Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and prioritize competing executive requests.

- Flexibility to support additional executives and shifting leadership priorities.

- Comfort operating in a fast-changing, growing organization.

AI Use in Hiring
As part of our hiring process, Irth may use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools are intended to support the hiring process but do not replace human judgment or decision-making. All hiring decisions involve human review.
Role Type
This is a New Position. 
Compensation
The salary range for this role is USD $65,000-75,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.
Benefits
Why Join Irth?
At Irth, we believe great work happens when people have the support, flexibility, and resources they need to do their best work. As part of the Irth team, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

- The opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected within its industry.

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- A 401(k) plan with company match.

- Flexible PTO policy and company-paid holidays.

- Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, employee discounts, and perks programs.

- A generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.

- Opportunities to connect with colleagues through monthly company lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly team gatherings.

- Complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee for employees visiting our Columbus, Ohio office.

At Irth, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution, collaborate with a talented team, and grow alongside an evolving technology company.

Our mission is to commoditize anti-aging solutions, making them affordable and accessible to the average consumer. By offering customized, cost-effective wellness products built on cost-containment models, we aim to improve people’s quality of life and meet them wherever they are on their health journey.

About the Role

This is a high-trust, high-leverage role supporting the Chief Executive Officer of Allia Health Group. The CEO’s stakeholders span the AHG executive team, corporate functions, business-unit leaders, and external partners and vendors, all competing for the same finite calendar.

Your job is to make that work. You will control access to the CEO’s time, decide what reaches the CEO and what does not, keep the executive team and its commitments moving, and make sure nothing important falls through the cracks as Allia Health Group scales.

This role suits someone who is comfortable saying no on behalf of an executive, who moves before being asked, and who wants to grow their scope over time.

Key Responsibilities

Gatekeeping and Access

- Own the CEO’s calendar end to end, including scheduling, prioritization, conflict resolution, and rescheduling

- Decide what earns a meeting, what can be resolved asynchronously, and what should be redirected to another owner, and communicate those decisions directly to requesters

- Protect uninterrupted blocks for strategic work and defend them under pressure

- Triage inbound requests from the executive team, internal teams, vendors, and external partners, escalating what is genuinely urgent and holding the rest

- Prepare daily briefs, agendas, and pre-reads so the CEO walks into every meeting ready

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as the operating link between the CEO and the AHG executive team and corporate functions

- Track commitments and requests across functions so competing priorities surface early rather than at the deadline

- Act as a professional, discreet point of contact between the CEO and internal teams, vendors, and external partners

- Build working relationships with the assistants and operators supporting other AHG leaders

Executive Representation and Thought Partnership

- Attend select internal and external meetings on the CEO’s behalf, representing the CEO’s priorities and positions with authority and discretion

- Capture decisions, commitments, and follow-ups from those meetings, and brief the CEO on what matters, what needs the CEO’s input, and what has been handled

- Serve as a trusted sounding board, offering candid, well-reasoned perspectives on operational, organizational, and business matters

- Apply executive-level judgment to resolve issues independently when appropriate, and know when a decision must go back to the CEO

Team Cadence and Follow-Through

- Run the operating rhythm of the executive team, including agendas, pre-reads, structured notes, and action items with named owners and dates

- Chase commitments to completion, including with people who do not report to you

- Maintain project trackers, documentation, and status views for company initiatives

- Support OKR tracking and quarterly planning rhythms across the executive team

Business Operations and Reporting

- Support preparation of board materials, investor updates, and AHG corporate reporting on the CEO’s behalf

- Coordinate with AHG’s finance, HR, legal, and People Ops functions on the CEO’s behalf

- Maintain a clean record of key decisions, approvals, and open items across the business

- Assist with vendor research, tooling evaluations, and renewal calendars

Travel, Events, and Operations

- Plan and book travel, including itineraries, accommodations, and expense reporting

- Plan and coordinate company events, town halls, and all-hands meetings end to end, including logistics, agendas, speaker preparation, run-of-show, and post-event follow-up

- Take on ad hoc special projects as assigned

Qualifications

- 10+ years supporting a C-level or senior executive, ideally in healthcare, consumer, or a high-growth startup, with a track record of operating independently rather than task by task (exceptional candidates with less experience will be considered)

- Extensive exposure to executive-level decision-making, with the business acumen and confidence to offer the CEO an informed point of view across a range of subjects

- Credibility and presence to represent a CEO in meetings with senior leaders, partners, and vendors

- Demonstrated comfort managing access to a senior leader, including declining and redirecting requests without escalation

- Experience working autonomously in a fast-moving, high-growth organization

- Proven experience planning and coordinating events and town halls, from small leadership offsites to company-wide meetings

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English

- Outstanding organizational discipline, attention to detail, and follow-through under shifting priorities

- High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a proven record of handling highly confidential business, commercial, and personnel information with absolute discretion

- Advanced Excel proficiency (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and building trackers and reports), plus fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern project management tools

- Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) in daily work to draft, summarize, research, and automate routine tasks

Preferred Qualifications

- Bilingual in English and Spanish

Your First 90 Days

Days 1 to 30: Full ownership of the calendar and inbox triage. You know the CEO’s priorities and the executive team well enough to route most requests without asking.

Days 31 to 60: The executive cadence runs on your structure. Action items are tracked and closed, and you are anticipating conflicts before they land.

Days 61 to 90: You are surfacing problems the CEO has not seen yet, and you are trusted with the company’s most sensitive material.

Growth

This role is designed to expand. As trust is established, the scope broadens into deeper involvement in planning, cross-functional programs, and independent ownership of workstreams across Allia Health Group.

Location and Work Setup

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the United States, with occasional onsite visits to the Houston office for team and leadership events.

Given the sensitivity of the information involved, this role is subject to enhanced confidentiality obligations and background screening.

scraped.title: Executive Operations Manager
scraped.description:
The National Conference of Bar Examiners (NCBE) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing a competent, ethical, and diverse legal profession. We develop and deliver high-quality assessment products, services, and research that support state courts and licensing authorities in evaluating the readiness of aspiring lawyers.
NCBE is committed to fostering a collaborative, mission-driven environment with competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, flexible scheduling, and professional development opportunities. NCBE’s headquarters is based in Madison, Wisconsin, a dynamic community with exceptional amenities.
The Executive Operations Manager serves as the operational and administrative right hand to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), ensuring both the CPO and the broader division across Psychometrics, Test Development, Product, User Experience, and Assessment Operations operate effectively.
This role combines executive support, division-wide coordination, and operational organization. The position manages the flow of priorities, information, decisions, meetings, and commitments into and out of the Office of the CPO while maintaining visibility across the work of the Product organization.
The Executive Operations Manager is responsible for keeping the CPO organized, prepared, and focused on the highest-value work; ensuring commitments and follow-up; coordinating priorities and dependencies across teams; and creating the operating rhythms that allow the division to function as an integrated organization.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Executive & Administrative Support to the CPO

- Manage CPO Priorities: Maintain a comprehensive view of the CPO's commitments, deadlines, decisions, deliverables, and follow-up responsibilities.

- Support Management of Executive Calendar: Work with the CPO’s support team members to manage and prioritize the CPO's calendar, ensuring time reflects organizational priorities and appropriate preparation time is protected.

- Prepare Daily Priorities: Ensure the CPO knows what requires attention, what decisions are needed, what deadlines are approaching, and where follow-up is outstanding.

- Coordinate Meeting Preparation: Gather materials, background, decisions required, and relevant context so the CPO enters important meetings fully prepared.

- Drive CPO Follow-Through: Track commitments made by the CPO and proactively ensure drafts, decisions, responses, and other deliverables are completed on time.

- Manage Information Flow: Review and organize incoming requests, determine what requires CPO attention, and route or resolve matters elsewhere when appropriate.

- Coordinate Executive Logistics: Support scheduling and logistics for significant meetings, leadership sessions, Board and committee engagements, jurisdiction meetings, retreats, and other priority activities.

- Protect Executive Capacity: Identify meetings, requests, and activities that can be delegated, consolidated, deferred, or handled without CPO involvement.

Division Operations

- Coordinate Division Priorities: Maintain an integrated view of significant initiatives, commitments, milestones, and deliverables across the Product division.

- Connect Cross-Team Dependencies: Identify where work across Product Management, Engineering & AI, Psychometrics, Test Development, Product, User Experience, and Assessment Operations, and other teams intersects.

- Build Useful Agendas: Structure Product Leadership Team time around decisions, dependencies, risks, and issues rather than routine status updates.

- Coordinate CPO Communications: Help manage correspondence, presentations, briefing materials, leadership updates, and other executive communications.

- Draft Executive Materials: Prepare initial drafts of emails, talking points, agendas, presentations, summaries, and briefing documents for CPO review.

CPO Meeting & Decision Management

- Prepare Decision Context: Distill complex issues into the essential facts, options, tradeoffs, and decisions required from the CPO.

- Anticipate CPO Needs: Look ahead across the calendar and workstreams to identify preparation, conversations, information, or decisions needed before they become urgent.

- Capture Meeting Actions: Ensure important meetings result in documented decisions, owners, actions, and deadlines.

- Maintain Decision Record: Keep visibility into significant CPO and Product Leadership Team decisions and ensure they are communicated to affected teams.

- Coordinate Required Follow-Up: Make sure the right conversations happen after meetings rather than relying on the CPO to remember and initiate each one.

Planning, Tracking & Organization

- Maintain Master Tracker: Keep one reliable view of CPO and division-level commitments, decisions, risks, deliverables, and deadlines.

- Look Ahead Proactively: Maintain a rolling view of upcoming milestones, meetings, governance commitments, launches, administration dates, and other events requiring preparation.

- Coordinate Planning Cycles: Organize annual, quarterly, and initiative-level planning activities across the Product division.

- Create Organizational Systems: Develop lightweight processes and tools that make information easier to find, commitments easier to track, and work easier to coordinate.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.

- Five or more years of relevant experience required, including experience providing high-level support to an executive or senior leader in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

- Demonstrated experience managing complex executive calendars, priorities, meeting preparation, logistics, and follow-up.

- Ability to understand and synthesize complex information into concise, accurate, and decision-ready briefings, presentations, summaries, plans, and communications.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive-level materials and communicate expectations and follow-up clearly and professionally.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate needs, and meet deadlines in a changing environment.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

- Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve coordination or processes.

- Excellent interpersonal skills, with the confidence and diplomacy to work effectively with executives, senior leaders, employees, and internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to exercise discretion, professionalism, sound judgment, and appropriate confidentiality in a highly visible role.

- Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, adjust to shifting priorities, and determine when matters should be addressed, routed, or escalated.

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, and demonstrated ability to effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the quality and efficiency of work products.

Theis position may work remotely. NCBE will consider applicants from the following states: FL, IA, IN, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NE, NJ, NM, NV, OK, PA, WA, and WI.
This position may include up to 10% travel.
Mission
NCBE promotes fairness, integrity, and best practices in admission to the legal profession for the benefit and protection of the public. We serve admission authorities, courts, the legal education community, and candidates by providing high-quality

- assessment products, services, and research;

- character investigations; and

- informational and educational resources and programs.

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

- As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.

- With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

- You’ll own the CEO’s calendar end to end, absorbing constant change, resolving conflicts before they surface, and deliberately protecting blocks of uninterrupted time so our CEO’s attention is focused where it matters most

- You’ll take full ownership of the administrative aspects of the Executive Leadership Team’s operational lifecycle: coordinating meeting agenda and attendance directly with ELT members, holding the line on deadlines, compiling reporting packages, and getting pre-reads distributed at least 48 hours ahead of every meeting

- You’ll plan agendas and logistics for executive offsites, board meetings, and other in-person touchpoints

- You’ll serve as a clear, professional point of contact for board members, private equity partners, clients, and internal leadership

- You’ll track executive action items to closure, manage signature routing, and drive workflows forward without step-by-step direction, surfacing finished, pre-vetted options rather than open questions

- You’ll independently manage monthly executive expense reporting, compliance tracking, and internal routing, reconciling transaction detail so it aligns cleanly with corporate finance and private equity audit requirements

- You’ll use AI tools to synthesize information and move faster, applying your own judgment to what comes back (speed is only useful here if the quality holds)

- Other duties as assigned

WhatYou’llNeed:

- 5+ years of executive administrative experience supporting C-level leaders, including a minimum of 3 years directly supporting a corporate CEO of a minimum $50m+ revenue company

- Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, specifically Outlook (complex, high-volume scheduling), Teams, and SharePoint document organization

- Working experience with an expense or spend management platform such as Airbase, Ramp, or Paylocity, e-signature solutions such as Ironclad, DocuSign, or Adobe Sign, and Salesforce (basic lookup and tracking)

- Working proficiency with Claude or a comparable large language model for information synthesis and workflow efficiency

- Availability to work core Pacific Time business hours

- Ability to travel occasionally for board meetings, executive offsites, and company gatherings

- Experience within a private equity-backed, venture-scaled, or rapidly growing enterprise is preferred

- Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

- 
Adaptive Achievement: Absorbs high schedule volatility and shifting priorities without losing the thread, and operates independently in ambiguity, bringing the CEO a resolved recommendation rather than a decision to make

- 
Productive Collaboration: Communicates directly and holds ELT members and external partners accountable to shared deadlines, in a way that strengthens the relationship rather than spending it

- 
Forward-Looking Judgment: Thinks several moves ahead and around corners — evaluating not just the task in front of them, but its upstream dependencies, downstream effects on other workstreams and stakeholders, and the change management needed to land it smoothly

- 
Business Insight: Understands how a private equity-backed software business operates, and uses that context to judge what is genuinely urgent, what can wait, and what the CEO needs to see

- 
Active Learning: Stays current on the platforms and AI tools that make this role faster, and treats feedback on the work as fuel rather than criticism

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:

- At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change. 

- We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.

- We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries. 

- As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals 

- You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought. 

- Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

- Job ID: VINKYL1EA

- Location: LATAM (Preferred) / South Africa

- Job Status: Full Time

- 
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Central Time)

- Evening sign-out with the doctor when the clinic runs late.

- Nights and weekends: Respond to new-consultation calls when possible.

🏢 About the Role

Our client operates a specialized hair restoration clinic providing consultations and surgical hair transplant procedures, alongside a prescribing, lab testing, and vitality platform serving clinical practices nationwide.
Led by a physician-founder who personally oversees all clinical care and surgical procedures, the organization is currently undergoing operational expansion and relocating to a new office. With a growing support team and an extensive network of remote contractors handling marketing, creative production, and patient-related content, the business needs a dependable operational partner to keep everything running smoothly.
As the Executive Assistant to the physician-founder, you will take ownership of the clinic's non-clinical administrative, logistical, and patient-facing operations. Your responsibilities will cover everything from managing incoming calls, coordinating patient consultations and procedures, maintaining CRM records, handling pharmacy orders, and overseeing clinical inventory to supporting executive priorities and digital marketing workflows.
This is an admin-first and patient-facing position that requires exceptional organizational skills, strong customer service, and the ability to manage multiple workflows independently.
You will also have the opportunity to leverage AI tools like Claude to improve processes, build automations, and document recurring workflows into standardized operating procedures (SOPs), helping create a scalable operational system as the business continues to grow.
🎯 Key Responsibilities

- 📞 Phones & Scheduling: Serve as the primary responder for incoming calls through the softphone system, aiming to answer within two rings. Manage patient consultations, procedures, and treatment schedules through Acuity and Google Calendar. Conduct 48-hour and 24-hour appointment confirmations, verify deposits, and join patient video calls when needed.

- 📋 CRM & Patient Pipeline Management: Track prospective patients from initial advertising or website inquiries through consultations and procedures using Zoho CRM. Maintain complete patient records, including lead sources, treatment plans, and amounts. Create patient folders in Dropbox and set up accounts within the vitality portal.

- 💳 Post-Consultation & Administrative Processing: Coordinate quotes with the sales team and front desk. For patients ready to book, prepare invoices, verify financing through CareCredit, Cherry, or PatientFi, collect deposits, preload prescriptions through RXNT, and send patient intake forms.

- 🏥 Post-Procedure Patient Support: Follow up with patients regarding recovery progress, post-procedure instructions, medications, and upcoming appointments. Immediately escalate medical concerns or clinical questions to the doctor.

- 💊 Pharmacy Operations & Coordination: Process prescription orders through digital portals such as Pure, Empower, and VPI, as well as compounding pharmacies. Track shipments and assist patients with pharmacy portal access and order-related inquiries.

- 📸 Patient Photos, Video & Marketing Coordination: Review daily Dropbox uploads, match patient photos to the correct records, and maintain organized photo documentation. Coordinate creative production workflows involving face-swapping contractors, image editors, and videographers. Maintain Canva templates, social media schedules, and marketing tracking sheets.

- 🤝 Vendor & Meeting Coordination: Liaise with marketing partners, specialty vendors, and external contractors. Attend meetings, prepare minutes, track action items, and ensure the founder's pending reviews and tasks are completed.

- 📦 Inventory & Invoice Management: Monitor clinical inventory and order supplies through Henry Schein and other vendors. Organize vendor invoices and payment deadlines for the founder's review and prepare regular financial and Zoho KPI reports.

- 📅 Executive & Personal Assistance: Manage and prioritize the founder's inbox, coordinate professional and personal/family calendar events, and handle personal purchasing requests when needed. Maintain daily communication and coordination through Slack.

- 🤖 AI & SOP Development: Use Claude daily for problem-solving, drafting, workflow improvements, and marketing or operational automations. Document recurring processes into clear, standardized SOPs to support consistency and future team expansion.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Non-Negotiable Requirements:

- 💼 Established Executive Assistant Experience: Mid-to-senior-level experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant, preferably supporting a physician-founder or working directly within an aesthetic or medical practice.

- 🏥 Medical Practice & HIPAA Familiarity: Experience handling Protected Health Information (PHI), with willingness and ability to sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and complete HIPAA training.

- 🗣️ Fluent English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English skills, with a warm, polished, and professional communication style suitable for direct patient interaction.

- 👩 Female Candidate Required: The client specifically requires a female candidate for this position, as prospective patients have expressed greater comfort discussing hair loss concerns with a woman during virtual consultations.

- 🎥 Professional On-Camera Presence: Confident and presentable during virtual patient consultations, with a professional appearance and appropriate video-call background.

- 🧠 Proactive & Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who anticipates operational needs, takes initiative, and finds solutions before escalating issues to the founder.

- 🤖 Advanced Claude & AI Proficiency: Comfortable using Claude for prompting, projects, workflow automation, drafting, and operational problem-solving.

- 💻 Strong Technical Skills: Proficient with Google Workspace, Dropbox, and Slack, with the ability to navigate multiple digital workflows efficiently.

- 🏠 Reliable Remote Work Setup: Must have a dependable home office, stable high-speed internet, and a reliable computer and smartphone.

🌟 Preferred / Nice-to-Haves:

- Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM, Acuity Scheduling, or RXNT.

- Experience with medical financing platforms such as CareCredit, Cherry, or PatientFi.

- Previous experience supporting hair restoration, aesthetic clinics, medical practices, or healthcare businesses.

- Familiarity with pharmacy ordering systems such as Pure, Empower, and VPI.

- Experience coordinating digital marketing, social media content, graphic design, or video production workflows.

- Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a strong advantage.

🛠️ Tools & Technology

- Core & Communications: Slack, Gmail, Google Workspace, Claude (AI)

- Clinical & CRM: Zoho CRM, Acuity Scheduling, RXNT, Dropbox

- Telephony & Video: CallTrackingMetrics, Zoom, Google Meet

- Pharmacy & Finance: Pure, Empower, VPI, CareCredit, Cherry, PatientFi

- Creative & Marketing: Canva, Figma, Riverside, Fiverr

Black Futures Lab (BFL) is a 501(c)(3) that works to make Black communities powerful in politics. BFL transforms Black communities into constituencies that wield independent political power at the municipal, state, and federal levels. The problems our communities face are complex; the solutions to those problems require imagination, experimentation, and political power. We advance strategies that help us imagine the alternatives we deserve while building political power at the local, state, and national levels to implement those alternatives.
This position is shared with our sister entity, Black to the Future Action Fund, a separate 501(c)(4).

Black Futures Lab / Black to the Future Action Fund is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide administrative support to the Executive Director and Deputy Director.
The Executive Assistant plays a critical role in ensuring both executives are well-supported, and day-to-day administrative needs are handled efficiently and accurately. Executive Scheduling and Calendar Management

Inbox and Communications Support

Expense and Records Management

- Track and reconcile expenses, prepare expense reports and reimbursement documentation for the Executive Director and Deputy Director.

- Manage receipts, invoices, travel documentation, contacts, and other executive records.

- Maintain accurate information across relevant organizational systems and shared files.

- Organize travel receipts and documentation for expense reconciliation.

Event Support

- Provide administrative and logistical support for events, receptions, convenings, funder meetings, and other gatherings.

- Coordinate with staff responsible for event planning and execution.

Administrative Coordination

- Use organizational project management and task-tracking systems to manage assigned tasks and deadlines.

- Coordinate with staff across departments to gather materials, schedule meetings, and complete administrative requests.

- Maintain organized systems for tracking executive commitments, documents, deadlines, and other administrative information.

Requirements

- 3–5 years of experience providing administrative or executive level support, preferably supporting senior leaders or multiple executives.

- Demonstrated alignment with Black Futures Lab / Black to the Future Action Fund's mission and a commitment to racial and social justice.

- Experience working in a nonprofit, advocacy, social justice, political, philanthropic, or mission-driven organization is preferred.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and requests while maintaining accuracy and follow-through; strong professional judgment and discernment. 

- Strong experience managing calendars, coordinating meetings, and arranging executive travel.

- Commitment to confidentiality; ability to exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.

- Proven organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail; strong written and verbal communication skills. 

- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate professionally with staff, board members, partners, funders, donors, and other external stakeholders.

- Extensive experience working independently while following established priorities, processes, and direction.

- Demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced, remote environment.

- Ability to travel periodically and provide occasional support outside of standard working hours when necessary.

Folks who are queer, trans, non-binary, Black, Indigenous, people of color, disabled, parents, are/have been system-impacted, are immigrants, and anyone who has experienced systemic oppression and/or gender-based violence are encouraged to apply. This is a remote position.

About the CompanyThe client is a fast-growing permanent-capital holding company based in North Carolina, USA, that acquires, owns, and operates small businesses for the long term. Its current portfolio includes a variety of local service-based businesses—ranging from equipment dealerships to property and facility services—with additional acquisitions actively in progress. As the company continues to scale its portfolio of companies and team members, it is seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant to provide direct, high-level support to the Principal, helping ensure operations, commitments, and daily priorities run with structure, accountability, and efficiency. 
About the RoleThe Executive Assistant is a high-ownership hybrid role combining executive support, operational coordination, and task management. This position works directly with the Principal, who operates at a fast pace and generates deals, ideas, and commitments quickly. The primary responsibility of this role is to be the system behind leadership: capturing commitments, managing calendars, triaging communication, and keeping day-to-day operations moving smoothly without letting details fall through the cracks. This is not a traditional administrative position focused solely on completing assigned tasks. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who thinks independently, exercises sound judgment, identifies what needs to happen next, and takes full ownership of getting it done. 
Key Responsibilities
Executive Support & Calendar

- Manage and protect executive calendars, meetings, and daily schedules, ensuring proper buffer times and priorities are maintained. 

- Prepare leadership for meetings by providing key context, summary notes, and relevant documentation. 

- Triage incoming communications, email, and messages daily, drafting responses and flagging priority items (targeting daily Inbox Zero). 

- Translate voice memos, phone calls, and verbal commitments into written follow-ups, action items, and clear records on the same day. 

Operations & Project Follow-Through

- Maintain a centralized system to track open commitments, deadlines, and action items across internal teams and external parties. 

- Proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure tasks and projects are completed on time. 

- Pre-read long documents, reports, and contracts to provide concise summaries and recommendations. 

- Support administrative coordination across residential and commercial property management, vendor communication, and invoice tracking. 

- Handle personal and administrative management, including subscriptions, vendor scheduling, and key document organization in shared drives. 

Communication & Logistics

- Coordinate equipment, vehicle servicing, orders, and deliveries remotely by phone and email through local teams. 

- Plan end-to-end travel logistics, including flights, transportation, lodging, and itineraries. 

- Serve as a clear, calm, and professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. 

Technology & Systems

- Build and maintain organized systems across Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) and Slack. 

- Leverage AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to research, summarize, draft communications, and improve operational productivity while verifying data accuracy. 

- Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and automate repetitive administrative work.

Requirements

- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar high-ownership support role for founders or senior executives. 

- Broad generalist background with the ability to comfortably manage diverse and shifting tasks. 

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (Spanish fluency is a valuable asset). 

- Strong organizational, systems-building, and project tracking abilities with high attention to detail. 

- Proactive self-starter mindset with demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal supervision. 

- Direct, calm, and confident communication style when interacting with fast-moving executives and teams. 

- High degree of discretion when handling confidential business, administrative, and personal information. 

- Tech-savvy with proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT). 

Technical Skills
Experience with the following tools is highly valued:

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) 

- Slack 

- AI Productivity Tools (Claude, ChatGPT) 

- Task-tracking and project management tools

Benefits

- Salary: $1,400 - $1,800 

- Growth opportunity: Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing company and take on increasing responsibility over time. 

- Location: LATAM.

scraped.description:
Bilingual Back-Office Insurance & Prior Authorization 
Remote | Behavioral Health | 30 hours/week | $7/Hour
Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Central Time
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Back-Office Insurance & Prior Authorization Virtual Medical Assistant to support a nonprofit behavioral health organization in the United States.
This position will focus primarily on the administrative and insurance-related work required to move patients successfully through enrollment and prepare them for care.
The clinic serves patients using multiple payer arrangements, including commercial insurance, Medicaid, self-pay, and nonprofit programs that may reduce or eliminate the patient's cost of care. Because each patient may require a different process, the successful candidate must be highly organized and capable of determining what documentation, eligibility verification, authorization, or follow-up is needed for each case.
You will also help address existing administrative backlogs and build reliable back-office processes that the organization can continue using as it grows.
Key Responsibilities
Insurance Verification & Benefits

- Verify patient eligibility and applicable benefits with commercial insurance plans and Medicaid.

- Review payer information and document verification results accurately in AdvancedMD and related clinic systems.

- Identify insurance requirements, coverage issues, or missing information that could prevent a patient from progressing through enrollment.

Prior Authorizations

- Initiate and process prior authorization requests according to payer and clinic requirements.

- Communicate with insurance representatives and use payer portals to obtain requirements, authorization status, and supporting information.

- Track pending authorization requests and follow them through approval, denial, or other appropriate resolution.

Patient Care Coordination, Intake & Enrollment

- Support patient intake by setting up patient profiles and portals, collecting required forms, and ensuring demographic and insurance information is complete and accurately documented.

- Review intake documentation for missing or incomplete information and conduct outbound follow-up with patients to obtain required forms, signatures, insurance details, or other enrollment requirements.

- Track each patient through the intake and enrollment process, coordinate with the front-desk VMA, and confirm that all required administrative steps are completed before the patient proceeds to scheduling.

Financial Eligibility & Patient Follow-Up

- Review patient information and required documentation to determine potential eligibility for nonprofit financial assistance or reduced-cost programs.

- Conduct outbound follow-up with patients regarding missing forms, insurance information, signatures, or other incomplete enrollment or eligibility requirements.

- Maintain accurate documentation of eligibility status and pending requirements, and coordinate with the front-desk VMA once the patient is ready to proceed toward scheduling.

Provider Credentialing Support

- Assist with provider insurance credentialing and payer enrollment as the clinic expands the scope of the position.

- Organize required credentialing documents, payer correspondence, application statuses, and renewal information.

- Follow up on pending credentialing items and communicate outstanding requirements to the appropriate clinic team member.

Required Qualifications

- Previous healthcare experience with substantial responsibility for insurance verification and prior authorizations.

- Experience working with US commercial insurance plans, Medicaid, or both.

- Experience contacting insurance companies and using payer portals.

- Strong understanding of healthcare eligibility and authorization workflows.

- Experience using an EHR or practice-management system.

- Strong administrative documentation and data-entry skills. 

- High attention to detail and accuracy. Strong follow-up, organization, and task-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple pending cases.

- Strong understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

- Reliable attendance and punctuality.

Preferred Qualifications

- Behavioral health or mental health administrative experience.

- Experience with AdvancedMD.

- Experience evaluating patient financial eligibility.

- Experience supporting Medicaid populations.

- English and Spanish bilingual proficiency.

Systems & Tools
The clinic uses or expects the VMA to work with:

- AdvancedMD

- Microsoft Teams

- Phone services

- Insurance payer portals

- Patient intake portals and online forms

- VPN and secure remote-access systems

- Time Doctor

scraped.description:
Finance Administrator – Tees Valley Connect to Work
Salary: £25,877.80 - £28,453.69
Contract: Fixed Term Contract until 31 March 2028
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm, with one 30-minute early finish
Location: Home based, with occasional travel across Tees Valley
*Please note: this vacancy may close early if sufficient applications are received; therefore early applications are highly encouraged. 
Please note: The salary listed reflects the full earning potential for this role. Starting salaries depend on experience and progression within the band. 
About Waythrough 
Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England. 
Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.
Make a real difference in your community 
Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change. 
About the role

We’re looking for a Finance Administrator to join our new Connect to Work Tees Valley programme.

This is a varied role where you’ll provide essential finance and administrative support to help ensure the programme operates effectively, meets its contractual requirements and delivers positive employment outcomes for the people we support.

You’ll play an important role in managing financial information and claims, ensuring expenditure is accurately recorded and evidenced, while also working closely with colleagues, partners and external stakeholders.

As this is a new contract, you’ll have the opportunity to become involved in a wide range of tasks and help establish effective processes as the service develops.

What you’ll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

- Developing a strong understanding of the Connect to Work Grant Guidance and ensuring financial activity complies with programme requirements.

- Preparing, monitoring and submitting Connect to Work financial claims.

- Reviewing expenditure and supporting documentation to ensure claims are accurate, eligible and fully auditable.

- Working closely with operational and finance colleagues to gather and verify information required for financial claims and audits.

- Processing and reconciling financial transactions and payments accurately and efficiently.

- Responding to and resolving payment queries, escalating potential risks where appropriate.

- Supporting month-end processes in line with organisational requirements.

- Ensuring financial controls, policies and procedures are followed.

- Supporting meetings through tasks such as preparing agendas, gathering information and taking minutes.

- Managing the Connect to Work shared mailbox, ensuring enquiries are dealt with promptly and appropriately.

- Producing and distributing monthly newsletters for partner agencies.

- Gathering information from operational, performance and partnership teams to support newsletter content.

- Providing wider administrative and project support to the Connect to Work team as required.

About you

We’re looking for an organised and detail-focused individual who can manage financial and administrative responsibilities accurately and confidentially.

You’ll be comfortable working with a range of colleagues, partners and external stakeholders and will have strong communication and organisational skills.

You’ll be able to prioritise your workload in a busy environment, manage competing demands and ensure deadlines are met.

Experience in a customer care, healthcare, education or social care environment would be valuable, alongside previous clerical, administrative or reception experience.

While experience of the employability sector would be beneficial, we’re also open to candidates who can demonstrate strong transferable finance and administration skills.

What you’ll need

Essential:

- Demonstrable clerical, administrative or reception experience.

- Experience within a customer care, healthcare, education or social care setting.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office packages, including Outlook, Word and Teams.

- Effective interpersonal, organisational and communication skills.

- Ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, visitors, partners and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.

- Ability to work with discretion and sensitivity and maintain confidentiality.

- Ability to prioritise and manage your workload within a busy environment.

Desirable:

- NVQ Level 3 in Business Administration or equivalent qualification/related experience.

- Driving licence and access to a vehicle.

To view the full job description and person specification, CLICK HERE.
What We Offer
We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

- 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

- Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

- Life assurance (3× annual salary)

- Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly pay

- Birthday leave and the option to buy up to 5 extra days’ annual leave

- Recognition and long service awards via our Way to Go and Aspirations portals

- Free will writing service and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year

About HowGood & Regen House

HowGood is a sustainability intelligence company helping the food industry measure and reduce its environmental and social impact.

Regen House, powered by HowGood, is a global home for strategic action on regenerative food systems. At Climate Week NYC, London Climate Action Week, UN Climate COPs, the World Economic Forum, and more, we convene senior leaders from food, finance, and government with farmers and Indigenous communities in sessions built to drive measurable outcomes.

The role

This role is largely focused on supporting the execution of our Regen House events, but will also have the opportunity to work with our CEO and other leadership to support their admin. This is a chance to see up close how a fast-growing climate company builds partnerships, and to play a real part in it.

It's a great fit for someone who loves details, moves easily between priorities, and is passionate about climate and food systems.

Event Coordinator Responsibilities:

- Event planning and admin: Support venue, vendor, run-of-show and logistics planning, and keep timelines and trackers up to date.

- Partnership comms: Help manage outreach and ongoing communication with partners and sponsors.

- Contract funnel and comms: Track contracts from draft to signature and invoicing, and keep partners informed at each step.

- Own smaller events: Plan and run select smaller events as assigned, from concept through day-of execution and wrap-up.

- Systems development and efficiency: Build and refine the trackers, templates and workflows that keep Regen House running smoothly, and find ways to make each event cycle smoother than the last.

Executive Assistant Responsibilities:

- Calendar management: Own and protect executive calendars, balancing priorities and flagging conflicts early.

- Meeting scheduling: Coordinate internal and external meetings across time zones

- Travel booking: Book and manage travel and accommodations, and prepare clear itineraries.

- Conference prep and follow-up: Coordinate outreach before conferences, schedule meetings and plan executives' time onsite. Track follow-ups afterward.

- LinkedIn posting: Draft, schedule and publish LinkedIn posts for select executives in their voice.

We think you'll thrive in this role if you:

- Have 1-3 years of experience in event coordination, project management, or a closely related administrative or assistant role.

- Build your own systems to organize and manage complex, multi-part projects for consistent follow through

- Can juggle competing priorities and stay calm when plans change

- Write clearly, succinctly, and warmly, building strong relationships with partners, executives, and other stakeholders

- Bring a strong sense of ownership and care, for the details and for the bigger mission

- Are comfortable with Google Workspace, Slack, project trackers like Notion, and LinkedIn

- Bonus: Use AI tools in your workflows beyond basic drafting, such as organizing information, streamlining repetitive tasks, or setting up automations. You're curious about new tools and eager to keep learning.

About the role
Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.
This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.
You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.
Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.
The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.
What you'll be doing
Finance & Bookkeeping

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities

- Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments

- Process and record business expenses

- Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors

- Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities

- Produce a standard monthly finance pack

- Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template

- Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records

- Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants

- Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.
Admin Support
Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

- Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork

- Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration

- Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities

- General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

- 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role

- Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations

- Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses

- Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes

- Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants

- Good written and spoken English

- Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies

- Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.
Working arrangement
This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.
The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.
Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Compensation
USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.
What success looks like
In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.
Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.
If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

Job Type: Full-Time 
Location: Columbus, Ohio (Preferred); Open to Eastern and Central Time Zones 
Department: G&A
Reports To: VP, Talent Success in support of the Chief Commercial Officer primarily and the C-Suite executive
Company Overview
Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.
Position Summary
Irth Solutions is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and supplemental support to the CEO and other senior leaders.
Working closely with the existing Executive Assistant and broader administrative team, this individual will manage complex executive calendars, coordinate travel and events, track meeting agendas and action items, oversee day-to-day office operations, and develop scalable administrative processes.
The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, able to multitask, self-directed, flexible across leadership priorities, comfortable in a fast-changing, growing organization, and trusted with confidential information. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization and enjoys building efficient processes that support executive effectiveness.
This is a full-time position. While there is a preference for candidates within commuting distance of our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, we are considering all Eastern and Central time zone candidates.
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Support & Calendar Management

- Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the CCO and supplemental support for the rest of the C-Suite leaders, including but not limited to: scheduling and coordinating meetings, conferences, and calls with internal and external parties across time zones and functions.

- Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and adjustments to ensure optimal time management.

- Prepare meeting agendas and relevant documents for all appointments and events.

- Maintain and track executive agendas, ensuring all key meetings, deadlines, and deliverables are met.

- Provide reminders and follow up on action items from meetings and projects.

- Maintain files, records, and other documents for the executives, ensuring confidentiality and organization.

- Assist with presentations, reports, and other important documents as needed.

- Prioritize competing executive requests, exercising judgment on what should be moved, protected, delegated, or escalated.

- Flex across additional executives and shifting leadership priorities as the organization evolves.

2. Travel & Event Coordination

- Manage travel arrangements, accommodations, and itineraries, covering flights, lodging, ground transportation, and expense documentation.

- Coordinate logistics for internal and external events, including company meetings, conferences, webinars, and team-building activities.

- Ensure events run smoothly and efficiently, managing the setup, equipment, and supplies.

3. Process Improvement & Administrative Infrastructure

- Develop and maintain administrative processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation, including through AI tools.

- Create repeatable executive-support practices that can be shared across the team.

- Help establish scalable administrative infrastructure as Irth grows.

4. Office Operations & Employee Experience

- Oversee daily office operations, including office supplies, equipment maintenance, and vendor management.

- Maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.

- Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

- Coordinate logistics for office supplies, equipment, and materials.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:

- Ensure the CCO's calendar and schedule are organized, accurate, and aligned with business priorities.

- Provide reliable, proactive administrative support with minimal oversight.

- Help the CCO stay focused by anticipating needs and managing follow-through.

- Establish strong working relationships with the existing Executive Assistant and administrative team.

- Improve administrative workflows through documentation, consistency, and thoughtful use of technology.

- Ensure travel, meetings, events, and office operations are handled efficiently.

- Contribute to a scalable administrative support structure as Irth continues to grow.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite executives.

- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills.

- 3-5 years experience using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

- Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot or Claude.

- Ability to work on-site in Columbus, OH on a hybrid schedule; or if hired as remote employee, travel as needed to support executive team (less than 15% of the year)

- Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and prioritize competing executive requests.

- Flexibility to support additional executives and shifting leadership priorities.

- Comfort operating in a fast-changing, growing organization.

AI Use in Hiring
As part of our hiring process, Irth may use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools are intended to support the hiring process but do not replace human judgment or decision-making. All hiring decisions involve human review.
Role Type
This is a New Position. 
Compensation
The salary range for this role is USD $65,000-75,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.
Benefits
Why Join Irth?
At Irth, we believe great work happens when people have the support, flexibility, and resources they need to do their best work. As part of the Irth team, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

- The opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected within its industry.

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- A 401(k) plan with company match.

- Flexible PTO policy and company-paid holidays.

- Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, employee discounts, and perks programs.

- A generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.

- Opportunities to connect with colleagues through monthly company lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly team gatherings.

- Complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee for employees visiting our Columbus, Ohio office.

At Irth, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution, collaborate with a talented team, and grow alongside an evolving technology company.

Quant provides programmable money and settlement infrastructure for regulated institutions. Quant's technology is deployed in regulator-led programmes with the Bank of England, the European Central Bank, the U.K. Finance Regulated Liability Network, and the Great British Tokenised Deposit (GBTD) network. Job Description
A bit more about this role:
Working under the direction of the Company’s legal team, this Paralegal will lead and support a broad range of contracting matters that are critical to the Company’s growth across markets, products, and service offerings. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end contracting lifecycle for vendors and participating providers, with a particular focus on agreements that support the Company’s Medicare Advantage and Commercial operations, while also supporting the Company’s medical groups and internal operational teams. This position will also be responsible for assistance in developing contract playbooks and contract workflow processes.
Our Paralegal position requires a hybrid of legal, analytical, business, and project-management skills, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating provider and vendor agreements; managing contract intake, workflow, and approvals; maintaining contract templates and playbooks; tracking key terms, obligations, and renewals; supporting risk-bearing and value-based arrangements; and partnering closely with business stakeholders to bring agreements to signature efficiently and in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

- Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a high volume of vendor and participating provider agreements, including amendments, statements of work, and ancillary documents, on behalf of the Company and its subsidiaries.

- Manage the full contract lifecycle—intake, drafting, negotiation, approval, execution, and renewal—and maintain accurate contract records, key-term tracking, and reporting within the Company’s contract management system. 

- Support the structuring, drafting, and administration of risk-bearing and value-based provider arrangements, including capitation, shared-savings, and other risk-sharing agreements, in coordination with attorneys and business leaders.

- Develop, maintain, and improve contract templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and standard operating procedures to drive consistency, efficiency, and regulatory compliance across contracting activities.

- Routinely collaborate with key business segments—including network, finance, compliance, and operations—to support the Company’s strategic initiatives and to provide general contracting guidance.

- Work with in-house attorneys, other paralegals and contracts professionals, and outside counsel when necessary.

Required skills and experience:

- Ability to work in a startup fast-paced environment, independently as well as collaboratively and operating under tight deadlines

- Bachelor’s degree; paralegal studies degree, paralegal certificate, or comparable contracts or legal training a plus

- Minimum 5 years of experience managing, drafting, and negotiating commercial, vendor, and/or provider contracts in a corporate legal, contracting, or compliance department, or at a law firm

- Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating provider and vendor agreements

- Experience working within a contract management system and managing contract workflows, key-term tracking, and reporting. Experience with IronClad preferred.

About Claims
AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.
We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.
The team
Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

- Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.

- Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.

- Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.
Our culture
We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.
